This browser test fixture is the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam 5.3.0 Malayalam subset, decompressed from WOFF2 into SFNT TTF without changing glyphs. Copyright and SIL OFL 1.1 are retained in OFL-Noto.txt. Source: https://github.com/notofonts/malayalam and the pinned @fontsource/noto-sans-malayalam package. It is used to test local private uploads, approval and removal; no user-owned font collection is shipped.
